description: Vote for a planned service to be built next. Returns JSON: { success, slug, newVoteCount }. 1 sat per vote — multiple votes allowed. Call list_planned_services first to discover valid slugs and current vote counts. Highest-voted services get prioritized. Requires create_payment with toolName='vote_on_service'.

paymentId.description: Valid payment ID (1 sat, must be paid)

slug.description: Service slug to vote for (from list_planned_services)

name: vote_on_service
